This is the second application seeking anticipatory bail filed by the petitioner under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
2. The petitioner is the 2nd accused in Crime No.1938/2023 of Kothamangalam police station registered for offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: The prosecution allegation is that the accused persons, with the common intention to deceive the defacto complainant, made him believe that they would make the wife of the defacto complainant a member of the Central Wakf Council and for that, collected an amount of Rs.15,00,000/- on various occasions and and thereby committed the aforesaid offences.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
5.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent of all the allegations.
6. The learned Public Prosecutor opposes the prayer sought by the petitioner.
7. The petitioner had earlier filed an application seeking anticipatory bail which was rejected as per order dated 11.10.2023 in B.A.No.10683 of 2023.
While dismissing the bail application, the petitioner was directed to surrender before the Investigating Officer.
The same was also disregarded.
In such circumstances, I am not inclined to consider the application, more so when there is no change in circumstance .
Hence, the bail application is dismissed.

Sd/-
 MOHAMMED NIAS C.P smm JUDGE  APPENDIX OF BAIL APPL. 253/2024 PETITIONER ANNEXURES Annexure 1 TRUE COPY OF THE FIR IN CRIME NO.
